test_title: PYST 6: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 27 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'PUNCH' is written as 'IDOVQ' and ‘CRACK’ is written as ‘LDBSD’. How will ‘BREAK’ be written in that language?
solution:
**Alphabetical order with its placed value:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a827e903e52c199d8cea030f3655db9b02da63af4503920b2e34c4d18d2c5d.png] 

The pattern in the given series is:

The letters are increased to 1 positional value and the code word is arranged backwards:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e0586eac69da4ce54b2ec2c429ab4c2bc98e15441fd0e9d458f9d736cf07635.png] 

PUNCH becomes IDOVQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/213dbc38060cad85581676e779ee8909b70385fa114453a198d589ce70c1b574.png] 

CRACK becomes LDBSD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71be3c82b78bf44bad9869fe7b2dded2d5bfcebc02ff2665a4eb198353d15575.png] 

BREAK becomes LBFSC

Hence **the correct answer is LBFSC.**
